news.analysis: Daniels and the Washington offense got off to a slow start on a rainy night at Northwest Stadium as they didn't score their first points until the second quarter. That being said, with the Commanders trailing 20-19, Daniels completed two long passes to Antonio Williams with less than a minute left in the game to set up a game-winning 26-yard field goal. Daniels has thrown for 10 touchdowns and two interceptions while adding 335 rushing yards and two scores on the ground in eight games this year. He will be a solid QB1 in fantasy in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.
news.contents: Jayden Daniels completed 23 of his 35 passes for 289 yards and added six rushes for 55 yards in a 22-20 win over the Bengals in Week 11's Monday night game.
news.title: Jayden Daniels throws for 289 yards in MNF win

Vidal finished with two carries for zero yards as Omarion Hampton stole the show on Monday Night Football. The 25-year-old was uninvolved in the offense and saw his lowest snap percentage since Week 3. With Hampton's emergence, Vidal's fantasy value slides back to a handcuff running back at best. news.analysis: Okonkwo finished second on the Commanders in receiving in the win on Monday night. He did most of his damage on a 32-yard catch-and-run in the second quarter, which helped set up a one-yard touchdown run for Jacory Croskey-Merritt. Okonkwo has caught 31 passes for 329 yards through eight games for the Commanders this season. He will be a TE2 in Week 12 vs. the Cardinals.

McPherson has now made 15 of his 16 field-goal attempts and added 35 extra points this season. He will kick against the Saints in Week 12.

McPherson missed his first kick of the season on a 43-yard field goal attempt in the second quarter of Week 10. Despite the missed field goal, the Bengals kicker was perfect on all five of his extra-point attempts in the contest. news.analysis: McCarthy didn't have a big game by any means, but he did enough to keep the Giants ahead and in control for the majority of the game, and greatly helped by the defense putting them in good spots. It would have been nice to see him complete more than 50% of his passes, but he isn't complaining after the win.
news.contents: J.J. McCarthy completed 18-of-38 passes for 173 yards and a touchdown and also ran seven times for 33 yards in the Giants' 23-18 win over the Jaguars.
news.title: J.J. McCarthy has modest game against Jaguars

news.contents: New York Giants quarterback J.J. McCarthy will face one of the better defenses in the NFL in the Jacksonville Jaguars in Week 11. They have been lockdown against opposing quarterbacks this season, allowing an average of just 13.2 fantasy points per game. Though they're bottom-half in the league in passing yards per attempt allowed, they've been adept at preventing opposing signal-callers from pushing the ball into the end zone. McCarthy has shown solid rushing upside, which has helped lift his ...
news.title: J.J. McCarthy Faces Tough Week 11 Test As Giants Starting QB

news.analysis: Etienne continues to serve as the backup behind Chuba Hubbard. He is not currently seeing enough touches to be fantasy viable heading into Week 12.
news.contents: Trevor Etienne rushed for 29 yards on six carries in a 35-33 win over the Ravens. He caught his lone target for seven yards.
news.title: Trevor Etienne sees seven touches in Week 11 win

news.contents: Carolina Panthers running back Chuba Hubbard handled 27 of the backfield's 33 carries in Sunday's 35-33 win over the Baltimore Ravens. He ran for 120 yards, scored twice and added a two-point conversion. Trevor Etienne took the other six carries. Hubbard's longest run took Carolina inside the five early in the third quarter, and he finished the drive with a one-yard touchdown that put the Panthers back in front. Hubbard has now carried 27 times in back-to-back games. He went without a target ...
news.title: Chuba Hubbard's Lead Role Keeps Him in RB2 Range

news.analysis: Meyers was quiet in the close loss in a game where Joe Burrow spread the ball around to nine different pass-catchers. The rookie wideout will continue to be boom/bust as the No. 3 receiver in Cincinnati. Sitting on 21 catches for 244 yards and one touchdown in 10 games this year, he gets the Saints in Week 12.
news.contents: Dohnte Meyers caught one of his two targets for two yards in a 22-20 loss to the Commanders in Week 11.
news.title: Dohnte Meyers held to one catch in Week 11

news.analysis: Sutton led Denver with nine targets in Week 9, albeit in a game Jaylen Waddle exited with a concussion. With the latter back in the lineup Sunday, Sutton saw just two targets. The Broncos scored a season-high 38 points, and Sutton didn't factor into the scoring. He's difficult to justify rostering in standard-sized fantasy leagues.

Geno Smith hit him for 33 yards in the second quarter, and Cade Klubnik found him for 29 in the third. Wilson drew five targets in the first half and nine in the second, staying involved through the quarterback changes. RotoBaller has him at WR10 for Week 11, with 13 catches for 189 yards on 26 targets over his last two ...

news.analysis: Washington averaged 4.7 yards per carry and had just two fewer carries than Ashton Jeanty. The difference? Jeanty saw eight targets, catching five passes for 90 yards and a touchdown, while Washington wasn't targeted. The rookie warrants a roster spot as Jeanty's handcuff but isn't a reliable standalone fantasy option.
